messages:
maya: Proposal — lightweight partial retention for rare error traces. Keep a small request prefix (128 bytes) + an HMAC/sha fingerprint for 24h to enable debugging without retaining full PII. Store only hashed PII, never plaintext. Thoughts?
kevin: Quick q — does this affect token billing/quotas? :thinking:
maya: It shouldn't change per-token billing; the retained blob is a separate telemetry artifact (encrypted, TTL'd). We need to ensure billing/usage metrics remain unaffected and that console UX makes it clear.
sarah: +1 on small prefix size. Main worry is embeddings paths — we must never keep vectors or model outputs. For any embeddings request we should strip vectors before retention.
luis: Can you sketch a config example? easier to reason about with fields.
maya: Sure — rough router config proposal: 
```json
{
  "partial_retention": true,
  "prefix_bytes": 128,
  "fingerprint_algo": "sha256-trunc16",
  "ttl_hours": 24,
  "storage_class": "encrypted-ephemeral",
  "embeddings_strip": true,
  "access": "audit-only"
}
```
anna: Ops question — default on or off? We should default OFF for tenants and require opt-in via console or per-tenant API.
maya: Agreed — default off. Opt-in gated behind an admin toggle + explicit consent checkbox in Console.
ops-bot: security-scan: quick-scan passed. Manual review required for KMS/HSM integration and audit retention policy. (ticket: SEC-4531)
kevin: Edge case: support may need to request full inspect for debugging (customer provides signed consent). We need a breakglass workflow (time-limited, auditable) and policy on who can approve.
sarah: +1 to breakglass + audit trail. Also recommend auto-redact step that pseudonymizes any discovered emails/SSNs before granting access.
luis: Implementation note: use sha256 and truncate to 16 bytes for fingerprint index. Keep prefix length configurable per-route. We can expose a minimum/maximum in schema.
maya: UX ask — Console should show a 'partial-retention' badge on requests retained and a link to the audit entry (who accessed, when). Also expose retention TTL in the request details.
kevin: I'll own the RFC for billing/ledger separation so retained blobs don't become billable units. Will include test matrix for quota regressions.
sarah: I'll add embedding-scrub unit tests in the preprocessing pipeline.
maya: If no objections, I'll open a PR with the retention middleware + e2e test that validates: 1) prefix kept, 2) fingerprint present, 3) ttl enforced, 4) embeddings removed.
luis: sgtm.
ops-bot: canary-scheduler: deploy to canary pool scheduled for Tue 02:00 UTC, tag=partial-retain-canary
anna: UX follow-up: add a brief tooltip text: 'Partial request retained for debugging; sensitive content hashed and ephemeral.' Also add link to compliance docs.
kevin: thanks — will sync with legal on the wording.
sarah: :+1:
maya: Thanks all. I'll open PR today and add the SEC ticket reference. Followups go in this channel.
ops-bot: thread closed by maya
